_help.scale: Uniform size. 1.0 fills the card width; 0.96 is 96%. Proportions are preserved.
_help.x_percent: Horizontal offset as a percentage of card width. Positive moves right; negative moves left. 0 is centered.
_help.y_percent: Vertical offset as a percentage of card height. Positive moves down; negative moves up. 0 aligns the pattern's top with the card's top.
_help.apply: Save this file and refresh the card page. Printing reads the same settings on each new print; no server restart is needed.
_help.color: Hex color tint, e.g. #c8e6b8. #ffffff keeps the rainbow colors unchanged.
_help.strength: Effect strength from 0 (invisible) to 1 (strongest). Applies on screen and to printed overlays.
_help.blend_mode: normal keeps the pattern visible on light artwork. Other supported modes: screen, overlay, soft-light.
